sources.title: Botond Szabó, Aad van der Vaart and Harry van Zanten, Frequentist coverage of adaptive nonparametric Bayesian credible sets, Annals of Statistics 43(4) (2015)
sources.locator: Full 40-page final arXiv version fetched and inspected. Focused units: model and procedure (2.1)–(2.7), printed pp. 5–7 (PDF pp. 6–8); Definition 3.2, printed p. 10 (PDF p. 11); Theorems 3.1 and 3.6, printed pp. 8 and 12–13 (PDF pp. 9 and 13–14); full proof of Theorem 5.1 in §5 and Appendix A, printed pp. 22–26 and 35–39 (PDF pp. 23–27 and 36–40); full sparse-gap proof in §9, printed pp. 32–34 (PDF pp. 33–35). The source's §2.1 first-coordinate convention and the index in Theorem 3.1 were checked against the PDF pages.

sources.title: B. T. Knapik, B. Szabó, A. W. van der Vaart and J. H. van Zanten, Bayes procedures for adaptive inference in inverse problems for the white noise model, arXiv:1209.3628
sources.locator: Full 41-page paper fetched and inspected. The main empirical-Bayes model and posterior are in §2, printed pp. 5–7 (PDF pp. 5–7); full Lemmas 5.2–5.3 and their proofs are in §§5.2–5.4, printed pp. 18–24 (PDF pp. 18–24); auxiliary weighted-series Lemmas 8.1–8.4 and supplied proofs are in §8, printed pp. 36–39 (PDF pp. 36–39).

contents.name: Empirical-Bayes sequence posterior and regularity maximizer setup
contents.reason: The local procedure definition fixes the 2015 source's likelihood and selector conventions; the 2012 paper's Sobolev-ball assumptions and contraction conclusion are not imported.

sources.title: B. T. Knapik, A. W. van der Vaart and J. H. van Zanten, Bayesian inverse problems with Gaussian priors, Annals of Statistics 39(5) (2011)
sources.locator: Full 33-page paper fetched and inspected. Sequence model and Gaussian prior/posterior setup are in §§2–3, printed pp. 2628–2633 (PDF pp. 4–10); Theorem 4.2 and the complete §7.4 proof compare posterior spread and frequentist bias for fixed hyperparameters, printed pp. 2635–2638 (PDF pp. 11–14).

contents.name: Proposition 3.1 Gaussian posterior formula and full proof
contents.reason: The local item proves the coordinate update directly by completing the square and then establishes the countable product version.

contents.name: Theorem 4.2 fixed-hyperparameter coverage regimes and full proof
contents.reason: This is an independent treatment of Gaussian credible-ball bias and spread, but it fixes the prior hyperparameter and does not prove the adaptive empirical-Bayes polished-tail theorem.

sources.title: Evarist Giné and Richard Nickl, Mathematical Foundations of Infinite-Dimensional Statistical Models, Cambridge University Press (2016)
sources.locator: Complete 705-page monograph fetched. Chapter 8, §8.3.3 gives the Gaussian sequence model, self-similar sequence classes and Theorem 8.3.16; its complete confidence-ball proof is in printed pp. 650–655 (PDF pp. 665–670). Theorem 8.3.16 uses sample splitting and a frequentist adaptive center, not a Bayesian posterior.

contents.name: Gaussian-sequence self-similarity conditions and complete proof of honest adaptive L2 confidence-ball coverage
contents.reason: This full-book treatment is an independent comparison for sequence regularity restrictions and coverage, but it proves a frequentist confidence-ball result rather than an empirical-Bayes credible-ball result.
